about: Hard sentences for testing the labelling guide. A tester receives id, claim, ask and text only (never expected or tests). ask is event:<kind> (answer: stated, denied, disputed or notMentioned), slot:<id> (answer: the slot's value) or value (answer: the normalised value). A difference between two testers, or from expected, is a defect of the guide until shown otherwise. Do not use these sentences in any note.
